title: Blood Transfusion by Boston MedFlight Registry
brief_summary: The primary aim of this observational registry is to study the outcomes of patients with hemorrhagic shock transported by Boston MedFlight receiving blood products during transport.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Adult patients who would be eligible to receive blood products;

  * systolic blood pressure \<90 mmHg
  * a shock index of \> 0.9
  * clinical signs of shock as determined by the transport clinicians.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years old
study_population: Any patient being transported by Boston MedFlight with hemorrhagic shock
